quotes.name: Rosalind Young
quotes.quote: Honestly, I can't say any city council person has ever reached out to me directly about anything. I run a small shop, I keep my head down, I pay my taxes. But I do notice things around the neighborhood — the little things that don't get fixed, the street maintenance that seems to lag, the way the sidewalks get cluttered. It's not one big thing, it's just a feeling that nobody's really asking the small business owners or the regular folks what we need. I haven't heard of any specific initiative for Laurel lately, and that silence kind of speaks for itself.
